test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series and complete the pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c242d7b52aa24eb896ce984da49d3a152d8dfdab77c939b08c2df601ebd8f4e1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) First box series →

All the element are flipped vertically.

The first two elements from the left end interchange positions.

The last two elements from the left end interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6146a9b5ac3b39dec0b54efa1e96478d90c0a52f03449929e725eb71bf034f4.png] 

2) Second box series →

All the element are shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdf3313c8f978e38b4181b1af321f42f94fffafb9ba55249b54274a2e4736492.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/134a5d5738dc4476f7dde0c40cd9bb3b9f4087008338bc219bbc5623df24287e.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
